description: This file defines serializers for abstract types in the Orleans serialization framework, including generic and non-generic serializer classes, with methods for writing, reading, serializing, and deserializing abstract types.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer<TField>
classes.description: Serializer for abstract types such as abstract classes and interfaces, providing methods for writing, reading, and serializing values of type TField.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializerWrapper<TField>
classes.description: A sealed wrapper class for AbstractTypeSerializer, implementing IFieldCodec for TField.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer
classes.description: Base class implementing IFieldCodec, handling serialization logic for abstract types with type information.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value, handling null references and delegating to specific codecs.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value, considering reference fields and specific codecs.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an instance of TField; default implementation is empty.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into an existing TField instance.

methods.name: ThrowMissingFieldType
methods.description: Throws an exception if the field type is missing during deserialization.
